4.1b  Tray beanie filling Locked

Decision. Tray beanies: EPE foam core + greyboard ears (locked). Hero beanie: cone form only.

4.2  Material — velvet

Both props are wrapped in the same blush velvet: short pile, approximately 2 mm.

Velvet, main#DFB8B6
Ribbon / trim#CB8190

4.3  Yarn balls

Ø60 mm balls at 56 mm pitch, filling the cavity behind the cat window, with loose balls scattered on the table top. Five colourways:

Rose#CF6E8F

Inspiration

4.4  Hangtag and ribbon

Six layouts, one per colourway, each pairing the beanie with its puffer. Card 110 × 179 mm, hung centred on the garment with its top edge at 23% of the garment height. Ribbon in the trim rose above, through the punched hole.
